build_vision_transformer: build a VisionTransformer model with configurable patch size, layers, and heads for image feature extraction
build_text_transformer: build a TextTransformer model with token embedding and causal attention mask for text feature extraction
create_multihead_attention: create a MultiheadAttention module supporting direct, qkv, per-head, and ov_circuit attention computation methods
create_residual_attention_block: create a ResidualAttentionBlock with LayerNorm, MultiheadAttention, MLP, and optional LayerScale for transformer layers
build_transformer_encoder: build a Transformer encoder stack from ResidualAttentionBlock instances with configurable width, layers, and heads
